title: replyTo circular reference not validated — UI traversal hang risk
description: Message/set create validates that replyTo references a message in the same chat that exists. It does not check whether the referenced message's replyTo creates a cycle (A→B→A). SQLite has no referential cycle constraint. A UI client that traverses the replyTo chain by following pointers will loop infinitely. This requires two colluding clients or a single corrupt insert. Not exploitable by a single peer via Peer/deliver (peer-delivered messages don't set replyTo). — Either add a cycle-detection check (walk up to depth N, fail if seen set repeats) or document the invariant as a known limitation with a code comment, so UI implementers know to cap traversal depth.
